editorial_review.notes: Four fresh developments are dated November 19-20: Anthropic’s IPO, Columbus’s live Thanksgiving Back distribution, the active FHA LEAP outage, and the current GPT-6.2 access state. BNY Project Perception is one explicitly labeled November 17 bank-AI dated update and does not count toward freshness. The lending lead is administrative workflow, banking AI is lane eight with company/vendor evidence and no disclosed metric, and frontier coverage is a compact access update distinct from November 18’s release segment. Markets and weather are routine. Final script is 1,895 spoken words with 22.7 percent COHOST contribution; all turns are under 100 words and six substantive COHOST questions receive useful answers.
